hook.text: Zara's network spans 12 countries, 1,600 suppliers, and delivers new fashion in 15 days. Network design is strategy.

buildup.text: Global network design decides where to locate factories, warehouses, and suppliers to serve worldwide demand.

discovery.text: Decisions include number and location of facilities, capacity allocation, and which products to make where.

twist.text: Network design locks in costs and capabilities for years. A bad location choice can't be fixed with better management.

climax.text: Amazon redesigns its network annually—adding fulfillment centers where demand grows fastest. Agility is the new normal.

punchline.text: Where you put your operations defines what they can deliver.

quiz.question: Why is global network design a long-term decision?
options: Facility locations lock in costs for years
